response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile individual-contributor engineer with broad full-stack and systems experience, but the role requires a CTO-level executive with 5+ years of senior technical leadership, a track record scaling engineering orgs from 10 to 30+, production multi-agent AI system ownership, and deep fintech credit/risk architecture experience — none of which are evidenced here. His current AI-agent work is a minor contribution to tooling, not production multi-agent system design at scale, and there is no leadership, team-scaling, or fintech-domain track record.
strengths: Broad, deep hands-on technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Some direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP tooling) and event-driven architecture concepts
Strong engineering craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source leadership) showing technical rigor
concerns: No executive or senior leadership experience — titles are Senior/Staff Engineer, not CTO/VP/Head of Engineering
No evidence of scaling teams (10→30+), managing technical leadership layers, or board-level communication
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI system ownership or fintech credit-risk/compliance architecture experience

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI or fintech-risk domain experience
Strong general engineering and distributed-systems fundamentals
